agents.availability_summary: All 5 agents are listed on ACP but their instances are NOT deployed/online to receive and deliver hires (verified 2026-11-06). Omega + WAVE consoles were directly verified showing “No Instance — Deploy to get online”. WAVE additionally needs a hosting payment settled before redeploy. No hire or subscription on this site can be fulfilled today.

capabilities: Browse the 544-world index (data.js / data/worlds.json) with place, biome, and group for every world
Play 7 flagship worlds in the browser 3D engine (player.html?world=<id>): third-person avatar, NPCs with dialogue and quests, collectibles, weather and day cycles
Open 29 interactive stations (workbenches, info desks, training bays, simulation bays) with grounded reference content, tools, and sources
Run 14 step-by-step practice simulations (explore.html?world=<id>&simulation=<simulation-id>), in order, with per-step checks; progress stays in the visitor's own browser
Teleport to a station's building door from the explore panel (engine controller.teleport; no-op without WebGL, panel still works)
Read every world definition as static JSON (worlds/<id>.json) — districts, buildings, interiors and furnishings, NPCs, quests, collectibles, stations, simulations

Browse all 544 WorldForge worlds in the walkable viewer (viewer.html?world=<slug>), including Master Cards per world (viewer.html?world=<slug>&card=<cardId>) — viewer base URL reported, not live-verified (see verification)

contact.note: Human-gated email only. There is no login, no API key, no OAuth flow, and no self-service registration endpoint. See auth.md.

limits: No API exists for this site: no endpoints, no MCP server, no status endpoint, no live data feed. The api-catalog lists static files only.
No login, no OAuth flow, no token, no register_uri. Human-gated email registration only (auth.md).
0 worlds live on RP1; every world in the index is rp1:null.
Only 7 GLB model files are hosted in assets/glb/; most buildings render as labelled procedural placeholders, never faked as the real models.
Simulations are practice only: nothing here certifies, diagnoses, treats, or qualifies anyone.
Agent companions (Omega, Tactile, ALS, CMMC, WAVE) are listed on Virtuals ACP but their live instances are offline; no hire can be fulfilled. In the worlds they are game characters only.
WorldForge viewer base URL is REPORTED (staged agent-readiness file), not live-verified: confirm the live WorldForge-Browser base URL before deploying any WorldForge absolute URL.
